Verdis API Documentation

Build carbon-negative Web3 applications using high-throughput REST APIs, streaming WebSockets, and EVM-compatible JSON-RPC endpoints on Chain ID 909.

Base URL: https://rpc.verdis.eco
Version: v2.4.0
Format: JSON / UTF-8

⛓️ 1. Blockchain Endpoints

Core ledger primitives, block queries, transaction submission, and chain sync stats.

GET /api/blockchain/info — Get current block height, hash, and sync state
▼

Returns general ledger status including latest block index, hash, transaction count, and network sync percentage.

curl -X GET "https://rpc.verdis.eco/api/blockchain/info" \
  -H "Accept: application/json"

Response Example (200 OK)

{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "chainId": 909,
    "blockHeight": 4820194,
    "latestBlockHash": "0x9f8e7d6c5b4a3f2e1d0c9b8a7f6e5d4c3b2a1f0e9d8c7b6a5f4e3d2c1b0a9f8e",
    "totalTransactions": 14208930,
    "synced": true
  }
}
GET /api/blockchain/blocks — Query recent blocks with pagination
▼

Query a paginated array of finalized blocks. Parameters: limit (default 10), offset.

curl -X GET "https://rpc.verdis.eco/api/blockchain/blocks?limit=2"
POST /api/blockchain/transactions — Broadcast signed transaction to mempool
▼

Submits a raw signed transaction hex string to the Verdis node mempool for propagation.

👛 2. Wallet Endpoints

Keypair generation, balance checking, staking, and asset transfers.

POST /api/wallet/create — Generate post-quantum compatible wallet keypair
▼

Creates a new Verdis Ed25519/Dilithium3 keypair and returns public address and secret seed.

curl -X POST "https://rpc.verdis.eco/api/wallet/create" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"type": "post-quantum"}'
GET /api/wallet/:address/balance — Fetch VRD and token balances
▼

Returns exact balance in VRD units (18 decimals) and registered ERC-20 equivalent token balances.

POST /api/wallet/send — Initiate zero-carbon token transfer
▼

Transfers native VRD or eco-tokens between addresses with automatic carbon offset fee calculation.

🔀 3. DEX & AMM Endpoints

Automated Market Maker pools, price quotes, token swaps, and green liquidity provision.

GET /api/dex/pools — Retrieve active liquidity pools and TVL
▼

Returns list of active liquidity pools (e.g. VRD/USDT, VRD/CARBON) along with reserves and 24h volume.

POST /api/dex/swap — Execute slippage-protected token swap
▼

Executes an atomic swap through the constant product AMM smart contract.

POST /api/dex/liquidity — Add liquidity to green pool
▼

Deposit token pair into AMM contract and receive LP tokens earning 0.25% fee yield.

📜 4. Smart Contracts Endpoints

Verdis VM bytecode deployment, state execution, and ABI inspection.

POST /api/contracts/deploy — Deploy bytecode to Verdis VM
▼

Deploys compiled bytecode. Accepts constructor parameters and returns contract address.

POST /api/contracts/execute — Call or write to deployed smart contract
▼

Executes contract method with argument payload. Support for read-only static calls or state-changing writes.

GET /api/contracts/list — List verified eco smart contracts
▼

Lists verified smart contracts deployed on mainnet with green impact certifications.

🌱 5. Eco & Sustainability Endpoints

Real-time carbon offset verification, reforestation tracking, and node green scores.

GET /api/eco/carbon-credits — Query retired & available carbon credits
▼

Returns on-chain carbon offset statistics verified by satellite data and Verra registry standards.

GET /api/eco/reforestation — Fetch tree planting coordinate registry
▼

Provides GPS coordinates, tree species, and growth estimates for forests planted via tx fee protocol rewards.

GET /api/eco/green-scoring — Node & validator sustainability index
▼

Calculates green efficiency score (0-100) based on energy origin (solar, wind, hydro) and hardware usage.

🛡️ 6. Validators & Consensus

DPoS validator registration, block production statistics, and governance voting.

POST /api/validators/register — Register new eco validator node
▼

Submit proof of 100% renewable energy certification and stake 100,000 VRD to join validator pool.

GET /api/validators/list — List active 21 consensus validators
▼

Returns the 21 active consensus block producers, uptime percentages, and blocks proposed.

POST /api/validators/vote — Delegate VRD voting weight to validator
▼

Delegate stake to earn up to 8.4% APY green yield from protocol transaction fees.

🔒 7. Security & Audits

Automated security audit logs, threat monitoring, and admin key rotation.

GET /api/security/audit — Fetch automated contract vulnerability report
▼

Returns automated static analysis check results for smart contracts deployed on Verdis VM.

GET /api/security/events — Real-time security telemetry feed
▼

Provides anomaly detection alerts, rate-limit triggers, and firewall block reports.

POST /api/security/admin — Rotate node access keys & API permissions
▼

Allows administrative keys rotation and scoped API credential updates.

🌐 8. Network Telemetry

Node status, latency, TPS statistics, and chain health metrics.

GET /api/network/info — Chain parameters and RPC endpoints
▼

Returns general node metadata, chain ID, Genesis timestamp, and active peers count.

GET /api/network/tps — Live and historical TPS metrics
▼

Returns instantaneous TPS, 1-hour average TPS, and peak throughput record (5,400 TPS).

GET /api/network/health — Complete system component health check
▼

Checks core component connectivity, database disk space, memory load, and peer count.

⚡ WebSocket Real-Time API

Bi-directional real-time event streaming for block minting, TPS spikes, and transactions.

WS wss://ws.verdis.eco/ws — WebSocket Streaming Connection

Connect via standard WebSocket protocol to receive instantaneous network events without polling.

Supported Event Subscriptions: block_minted, tx_confirmed, tps_update, validator_heartbeat.

JavaScript Client Example 
const ws = new WebSocket("wss://ws.verdis.eco/ws");

ws.onopen = () => {
  console.log("Connected to Verdis Eco Stream");
  // Subscribe to live TPS and block updates
  ws.send(JSON.stringify({
    action: "subscribe",
    channels: ["block_minted", "tps_update"]
  }));
};

ws.onmessage = (event) => {
  const data = JSON.parse(event.data);
  console.log("Realtime event:", data);
};

⚡ JSON-RPC 2.0 Method Reference

EVM and Verdis native JSON-RPC methods for Web3.js, Ethers.js, and Hardhat integration.

RPC eth_blockNumber — Returns latest block number hex
▼ 
// Request Payload
{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "method": "eth_blockNumber",
  "params": [],
  "id": 1
}

// Response
{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "id": 1,
  "result": "0x498b36" // Decimal: 4820022
}
RPC eth_getBalance — Returns account balance at block height
▼ 
{ "jsonrpc": "2.0", "method": "eth_getBalance", "params": ["0x71C7656EC7ab88b098defB751B7401B5f6d8976F", "latest"], "id": 1 }
RPC eth_sendRawTransaction — Submit signed raw transaction payload
▼

Executes signed raw transaction. Returns transaction hash upon insertion into mempool.

RPC verdis_getEcoScore — Native Eco rating query
▼

Returns validator or wallet green score metrics and verified carbon offsets.
